title: Main page service cards with water waves scroll animation and full pricing

requirements.text: Update the Home page to display all 8 service cards (Pest Control, Deep Cleaning, Painting, Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, AC Services, Appliances Repair) in a vertical stacked layout. Each card must animate into view one at a time as the user scrolls — using a water-waves / ripple pop-up effect (scale from below with a wave-like easing, not a plain fade). Cards should appear sequentially with a staggered delay so they pop up one after another.

quotes: Scroll madbekadre kelgininda melakke pop up agbeku water waves effect Alli
Main page alli scroll madbekadre service ondonde show agbeku with effect

acceptanceCriteria: Home page shows exactly 8 service category cards
On scroll, each card animates in one at a time with a water-waves / ripple-pop effect
Cards appear sequentially (staggered), not all at once
Animation triggers via IntersectionObserver (visible only when scrolled into view)

requirements.text: Clicking any service card on the Home page must immediately open that service's full categories and pricing inline or as an expanded panel/modal — with no intermediate navigation step or extra page. All subcategories and prices for the selected service must be visible directly upon card click.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a service card on the Home page directly reveals its categories and pricing without navigating to another page
No intermediate step or extra navigation required
All subcategories and prices for the clicked service are visible

Pest Control has three subcategory groups: Residential (flat), Commercial (per sq.ft), Construction (per sq.ft)
Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, AC Services, Appliances Repair all show ₹499 service visit charge
Add-on options are stored and shown for all services

requirements.text: For Pest Control's Commercial and Construction subcategories, show an inline square footage calculator inside the expanded card panel. The user enters a sq.ft value and the total price is computed in real time (e.g., 800 sq.ft × ₹6 = ₹4,800). Display the computed total prominently alongside a Book Now / WhatsApp button.

acceptanceCriteria: Commercial and Construction pest control subcategories show a sq.ft input field
Entering a sq.ft value calculates and displays the total price in real time
Book Now and WhatsApp buttons use the calculated price in the pre-filled message
Residential pest control shows flat pricing without a calculator

requirements.text: Display Add-on Options (Same Day Emergency +₹999, Sunday/Holiday +₹799, Warranty Certificate – Included) as selectable checkboxes or toggle chips inside every expanded service card panel. When selected, add-on costs must be reflected in the total shown and included in any WhatsApp or booking message.

Selecting Emergency or Holiday toggles adds the cost to the displayed total
